cc:Work.dc:title: Validation performance accumulates over time
cc:Work.dc:description: Cumulative mean loss over chronological validation matches, using fixed training-end ratings throughout. These are validation scoring paths, not epochs, optimization traces or online rating updates; the window selected the models.
